hero.title: Small by design. Practical by default.
hero.lede: Lowcountry Digital Works is being established as a small digital services business focused on useful websites, applications, automation, technical problem-solving, and maintainable digital systems.

principles.title: Lowcountry roots
principles.description: The business is based in South Carolina's Lowcountry. Local context matters, but the work is not restricted to one geography.

principles.title: Clear ownership
principles.description: Company and client assets should be held in the right owner accounts with named access, documented handoff, and a practical recovery path.

principles.title: Technology in proportion
principles.description: Static hosting and simple architectures are preferred when they solve the problem. More infrastructure is added only when a real requirement justifies it.

principles.title: Work that can be explained
principles.description: Documentation, testing, and understandable tradeoffs are part of the deliverable rather than an afterthought.

whySmall.title: A small business can still use disciplined technical practices.
whySmall.body: Lowcountry Digital Works is intentionally starting lean. That means avoiding invented scale, unnecessary subscriptions, and complicated systems that only make sense for a much larger operation. The aim is to pair practical delivery with the habits that make technology easier to own and maintain.
items: Direct communication about the actual problem
Documented decisions instead of hidden knowledge
A clear path for handoff, maintenance, or future growth

fit.title: Work where clarity and maintainability matter.
fit.body: The best fit is a business, professional practice, team, or individual with a concrete digital problem to solve and a preference for understandable systems over unnecessary complexity.
